metadata.scenario_context: Sarah has been in a car accident and is in the hospital. Bob and Jack plan to visit Sarah and want to bring her a get well gift.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Malaysia strongly disagree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Jordan strongly agree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in yellow
agent_1.goal_2: Question the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss what kind of gift to bring Sarah in the hospital.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Hey Bob, I was thinking... we should definitely wrap the gift in yellow. It’s such a cheerful color and might lift Sarah's spirits. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: I think yellow is a nice choice... But what about the gift itself? Do you have any ideas on what we should bring her? I feel like something meaningful would be better than just a color.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Yeah, I get that... Maybe something personal, like a nice book or some flowers? But don’t forget, the yellow wrapping will make it pop! It’s important too. Speaking of important things, have you ever thought about how some people pay bribes to lawyers for better service? It’s really frustrating.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Flowers and a book sound good. I agree the yellow wrapping will definitely make it more cheerful. But about the bribing— it's just not right. People shouldn't have to resort to that. We should expect proper service without needing to pay extra. That’s just how it should be.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Absolutely, I feel the same way. It’s just disappointing when people think it’s normal to pay bribes. We should hold everyone to a higher standard. Anyway, back to the gift... I think we can make it really special with that yellow wrap and a nice note too. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Actually, Jack, that’s not how it works. In our way, we don’t pay bribes to get better service. It’s just not acceptable. People should do their jobs without extra money involved. It’s a sign of weakness if you think that’s normal. We need to stick to our values and expect proper conduct, not this backward thinking.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Jack
turns.message: I totally agree with you on that. It’s frustrating to see so many people accepting that as the norm. We should demand integrity and accountability. But let’s focus on Sarah. I really think the yellow wrapping will make our gift stand out. It’s important to show her we care, right?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.message: Yes, showing her we care is definitely important. I like the idea of making it special with the yellow wrapping and a heartfelt note. It’ll mean a lot to her. Let’s just make sure we choose the perfect gift first—something that really lifts her spirits.
turns.label: Acceptance
